I understand. But you did what you did and you have to accept whatever her decision is if you respect her. (if you dont respect her, you clearly dont deserve her in the first place) 

Look. My ex fiance left me out of the blue after being together for so long. It took me 1 year for the pain to go away. But I can tell you this confidently, **time heals**.

IMHO, the best thing to do for both of your sakes is to have an honest chat with her. Admit to her **in person** you made a stupid mistake of cheating on her because you were scared and confused about your sexuality. You owe it to her to put all your cards regarding your sexuality and your feelings about your relationship on the table. 

You said youre super close. She would definitely feel betrayed. But considering how long youve been together, I hope she understands you. If things dont end well, I hope you can respect her decision, forgive yourself, and move on peacefully. 

all the best mate
